design_name: Post-outcome audit of target-domain OOD knowledge deficit and neighbor localization
status: diagnostic design frozen after the OBELiX outcomes and prior transfer results were known
claim_guard: This analysis quantifies the problem geometry and localizes existing source effects. It cannot create an independent OBELiX transfer claim or redefine the frozen screening and sequential nulls.

distance.representation: 126 frozen composition features standardized with the complete official-train feature distribution only
distance.metric: Euclidean distance to the nearest selected target-training entity
distance.strata: within-repeat quartiles of the official-test distance, with deterministic rank tie breaking

primary_problem_endpoints: target-only RMSE difference between OOD quartile 4 and quartile 1 at n=30
target-only Spearman association between absolute error and OOD distance at n=30
primary_borrowing_endpoints: thermoelectric-neighbor relative RMSE reduction in OOD quartile 4 at n=30
difference between thermoelectric-neighbor and best wrong/shuffled-source relative RMSE reduction in OOD quartile 4

inference.unit: paired initial-target-label repeat conditional on one fixed OBELiX test set
inference.warning: The interval is a conditional resampling diagnostic and is not dataset-level transport uncertainty.

success_interpretation.problem: Positive high-minus-low OOD error and positive error-distance association establish a target-only OOD deficit in this target.
success_interpretation.localization: A positive neighbor increment concentrated in high OOD and separated from all controls supports OOD localization only; failure remains a null diagnostic.
success_interpretation.no_rescue: No result from this post-outcome audit changes the completed OBELiX claim status.
